title: Legal Services to Immigrants NAQ
agency_path: City of New York > Youth and Community Development
description_text: Non-competitive NAQ for Youth Ministries for Peace and Justice (YMPJ). LSNY Bronx is no longer able to provide Legal Services for Immigrants. This contractor is to assist immigrants, including immigrant youths, survivors of domestic violence and trafficking as well as non-citizen, immigrant workers, in attaining lawful immigration status by providing legal counseling, application assistance, and legal representation to address immigrants social services needs directly or through referrals, and provide related legal services. These services are critical to New Yorkers.
